text: Agents can be defined via a simple YAML configuration file
quote: An agent starts as a small YAML config

text: Agents can be launched via dashboard, CLI, REST API, or TypeScript SDK
quote: Launch your first agent with Omnara via the dashboard, or programmatically with the CLI, the REST API, or the TypeScript SDK.

text: Agent conversation history persists across crashes, restarts, and disconnects so work can resume
quote: Agents keep their conversation history across crashes, restarts, and machine disconnects, so work can resume without starting a new conversation.

text: Supports multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Bedrock) or self-hosted models
quote: Use models from OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, or Amazon Bedrock, or connect a compatible model you host yourself.

text: Can connect MCP servers to give agents access to services/data, and add custom tools for app actions
quote: Connect MCP servers to give them access to your services and data, or add custom tools for actions in your own application.

text: Skills package instructions and supporting files for recurring agent tasks
quote: Skills let you package instructions and supporting files for work your agents do regularly.

text: Can watch agent progress live, send corrections while it works, or queue the next task
quote: Follow an agent’s progress live, send a correction while it’s working, or queue up its next task.

text: Can configure which actions require approval; agents pause to ask questions when needed
quote: You can decide which actions need approval, and agents can pause to ask questions when they need your input.

text: Can attach images and documents to an agent conversation
quote: You can also attach images and documents to a conversation.

text: Positioned as an open-source alternative to Claude Managed Agents
quote: Omnara — The open-source alternative to Claude Managed Agents

text: Free to self-host and build on, open source under Apache 2.0 license
quote: Free to self-host and build on. Open source under Apache 2.0.

text: Agents can run on a machine you connect, such as your own laptop or server
quote: or a machine you connect, such as a laptop or server

text: Users can bring their own model API keys for free
quote: Bring your own model keys for free

text: Organization/project roles can be assigned to users and API keys with separated permission levels
quote: Assign organization and project roles to users and API keys. Separate who can manage access, configure agents, operate them, or only view them.

text: Self-hosted deployments allow direct Postgres queries of agent history for analytics, evals, and training data
quote: Self-hosted deployments can query agent history directly in Postgres for analytics, evals, prompt analysis, and training datasets.
